metadata.source: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Elevation Point Query Service
metadata.limitation: Estimated/interpolated ground elevation from the USGS 3DEP elevation service at one representative coordinate. It is not flood depth, building height, floor or finished-floor elevation, structural elevation, FEMA Base Flood Elevation, vulnerability, safety, or current/future inundation.

properties.elevation_source: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Elevation Point Query Service
properties.resolution_note: Raw resolution reported by EPQS; the response schema does not name a resolution unit or human-readable source work unit.
properties.horizontal_reference_note: Existing OSM longitude/latitude was submitted with WKID 4326. EPQS documentation describes point inputs as NAD 1983; no additional local datum transformation was applied in this experiment.
properties.vertical_reference_note: EPQS does not return a vertical datum per point. USGS states that CONUS 3DEP DEMs are typically NAVD88, but the datum is not asserted here without work-unit or product metadata verification.
properties.accuracy_note: USGS describes EPQS values as interpolated rather than surveyed and reports an overall service RMSE of 0.53 m; local accuracy varies with source data.
properties.interpretation_note: Estimated/interpolated ground elevation from the USGS 3DEP elevation service at one representative coordinate. It is not flood depth, building height, floor or finished-floor elevation, structural elevation, FEMA Base Flood Elevation, vulnerability, safety, or current/future inundation.
